name: Botox
title: Botox in Tustin | Physician-Injected | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Botox in Tustin from Tariq A. Khan, MD. Softens crow's feet, forehead, and frown lines, and treats underarm sweating, chronic migraine, and TMJ tension.
lede: Dr. Khan has years of experience injecting Botox. It softens the wrinkles that come from repeated expressions, and it also treats heavy sweating, chronic migraine, and jaw tension.
glance: Physician-injected Botox for expression lines and medical uses.

signs.heading: What it treats
signs.intro: Botox works on dynamic wrinkles, the ones caused by muscle movement. Lines from collagen loss respond better to fillers.

basics.heading: How Botox works
paras: Botox is a purified form of botulinum toxin. A small amount injected into a specific muscle blocks the nerve signal that makes it contract, so the muscle relaxes and the line above it softens.
The same nerve-blocking effect is used medically. Dr. Khan believes his background in art and music, combined with his aesthetic training, gives him an eye for natural, balanced results.

options.name: Underarm sweating
options.text: Blocks the nerve signals that stimulate sweat glands.

options.name: Chronic migraine
options.text: Used to help prevent migraines in adults who have them 15 or more days a month, lasting four hours or longer.

options.name: TMJ & grinding
options.text: Eases soreness and facial muscle tension, and may relieve headaches caused by teeth grinding.

steps.heading: Your appointment
items: Dr. Khan looks at how your face moves and discusses your goals.
A few quick injections with a fine needle.
Effects appear over several days. Dr. Khan checks your result at follow-up.

faq: Results typically last a few months. Most patients schedule maintenance treatments. [DR. KHAN TO CONFIRM TIMING]
Most people return to normal activities right away.
Botox relaxes muscles that cause expression lines. Fillers like Juvéderm restore lost volume. Many patients use both. See Juvéderm.
[PRICE TO COME]. Concierge members have the office fee waived on cosmetic services.
